_comment: Ratified documentation-layout exclusions, keyed by repo slug.
A pattern takes effect only if it appears BOTH here and in the repo's own
[tool.agentic-os.documentation-layout] section. A repo-local pattern with no
entry here does not silently fail to apply: the hook fails and names it.
So adding an exclusion costs two pull requests in two repos plus a hook
release and a pin bump, and removing one costs a single pull request on
either side. That asymmetry is the point. See guides/ratifying-an-exclusion.md.
Every entry below was carried forward unchanged at centralization and is
scheduled for removal. A reason reading 'unreviewed' was never argued for in
a pull request anyone reviewed, which is why it is being drained.

agentic-os.reason: SSM.md is a load-point reference doc read by name, not relocatable into docs/ without breaking the references that address it.

agentic-os-hardware.reason: unreviewed. docs/plan/ is one nested body read front to back; the skill entries predate the SKILL.md size-cap exemption and may already be dead weight.

agentic-os-kai.reason: unreviewed. data/ is generated (repo digests, ssm-index, skill baselines). The nine SKILL.md entries are self-described size debt awaiting the split tracked in agentic-os-kai#464, and SKILL.md now takes no size cap anyway, so most of this list is inert.

agent-compose.reason: unreviewed. testdata/ and seed/roster/data/ are fixtures and generated roster data rather than authored prose.

deploy.reason: Multi-service monorepo: each service and shared chart co-locates a README and docs/ under services/<name>/ and charts/<name>/, which the root-plus-flat-docs placement rule does not model. Placement only. All 77 co-located docs sit inside the size cap unaided, verified 2026-09-08.

eco-app.reason: unreviewed, and the widest entry in this file. size_excludes covers the repo's OWN docs/ shelf, including a docs/FEATURES.md over the cap that exists to keep FEATURES.md an inventory. 24 files ride it.

eco-mods.reason: unreviewed. mods/ and the two unity/ trees carry co-located per-mod and per-package Markdown.

eco-ops.reason: unreviewed, and carries bare file paths in size_excludes, which is the per-file escape agentic-os#1108 removed, restored by name. 12 files ride it.

galaxy-gen.reason: unreviewed. docs/journal/ is an append-only journal (one file at 1589 lines); the skill entries predate the SKILL.md size-cap exemption; pkg/** is Go package Markdown.

housecast.reason: unreviewed. evaluations/ holds dated evaluation records rather than a doc shelf.

infrastructure.reason: unreviewed. The three README globs predate the outpost/homestead module-README shape, which turns a conforming co-located README into a rule rather than an exclude, so they may already be removable.

lore.reason: unreviewed. docs/FEATURES.md is excluded from the cap that exists to keep FEATURES.md an inventory, one of the two cases agentic-os#1108 named by hand.

sirens-echo.reason: unreviewed. agent/bundles/ and agent/compose/person/ are generated composition inputs.

website.reason: unreviewed. src/pages/ and src/projects/ are published Astro site source, so a blog post is capped as if it were a reference doc and the split-into-docs remedy cannot be followed. 18 files ride it.
